h1: Custom Collapsible Cups for Travel Gifts & Brands: Create Your Signature Look
lead: A campsite coffee. A festival weekend. A travel kit packed for the next trip. Build your branded silicone cup around the moments your audience enjoys.
html:
Create a Gift Around the Way Your Audience Travels

For an outdoor brand, the cup can be part of a wider kit. For an event, it can carry the identity of the occasion. Tell us who receives it and where it goes next, and we will help bring the model, colours, artwork and packaging together.

From your logo to the artwork, we help create a custom look that is unmistakably yours—bringing your brand’s personality to every cup, ice bucket and accessory.

Can you build the collection around our brand idea?

Yes. A campsite coffee. A festival weekend. A travel kit packed for the next trip. Build your branded silicone cup around the moments your audience enjoys. For an outdoor brand, the cup can be part of a wider kit. For an event, it can carry the identity of the occasion. Tell us who receives it and where it goes next, and we will help bring the model, colours, artwork and packaging together.

How can our logo and artwork make the collection our own?

From your logo to the artwork, we help create a custom look that is unmistakably yours—bringing your brand’s personality to every cup, ice bucket and accessory.

Where should we start?

Tell us about your venue, event or recipients, and share your colours, logo, references and initial product ideas. You can begin before every detail is settled. We will help organise the product, artwork, sample and packaging direction; include your opening or event date if one is planned.
